analysis:
WDC fell 17.1%, roughly in line with its memory and storage peers (median decline of 17.0%) but 6.3 percentage points worse than the sector benchmark SMH. Headlines focus on a broader tech and chip sector crash, with coverage noting Micron's 17% drop, a wider selloff spreading to AI-related industrials, Nvidia entering bear territory, and the Nasdaq posting its worst day in 18 months, which The Guardian links to election results and AI slowdown concerns.

This stock has a volatile history around earnings, with a median abnormal move of 8.3% beyond what the market explains. Notably, WDC has beaten estimates in seven of its last eight reports, yet four of those beats were followed by negative abnormal moves -- most recently a 13.2% beat on October 22 that brought a 1.4-point abnormal decline, and before that a 7.9% beat in August followed by a 12.5-point drop beyond the market. The company reports next on January 28, 84 days out.
